section.25: The Office of the Judge (Kitab Al-Aqdiyah)

25.name_native: The Office of the Judge (Kitab Al-Aqdiyah)

hadiths.text: Narrated Abdullah ibn Abbas: The Holy Prophet (ﷺ) said to a man whom he asked to take an oath: Swear by Allah except whom there is no god that you have nothing belonging to him, i.e. the plaintiff
